messages:
Asha (growth): Quick sync: we need to pick one headline for the webinar by EOD. Options: A) 'Scaling inference: benchmarks + cost playbook' B) 'Ship reliable LLM features: latency, cost, fallbacks'
Kei (content): I prefer A for SEO, but tweak to 'Real-world benchmarks & cost playbook'
Marta (product): Audience note: include enterprise use case and a short customer quote slide.
Liam (eng): For demos: plan main path on Hosted API and a Dedicated fallback. I'll prep both endpoints.
Asha (growth): Good. Also want two abstracts: short (1 line) and extended (2-3 sentences). Kei can you draft both?
Kei (content): On it. Draft short: 'Real-world benchmarks and operational patterns to reduce inference cost without degrading latency.' Longer: 'We’ll share benchmark methodology, live demos of routing and fallbacks, and actionable controls (batching, caching, quantization) to lower unit costs in production.' Thoughts?
Ravi (sales): Routing requirement: flag registrants with >$50k ARR as sales leads. Also tag 'demo-requests' checkbox.
Asha (growth): We'll add a required company size dropdown and a demo-request checkbox. Need webhook to SalesOps.
Liam (eng): I'll expose /webhooks/marketing/lead-router. Schema: name,email,company,company_size,interested_demo,true. Will post example payload.
Kei (content): Speaker roster: Marta (product overview), Liam (demo + fallback), Ravi (enterprise ask + follow-up). Host: Asha. Agreed?
Marta (product): Agreed. Can I get 5 minutes for roadmap tie-in? Keep it high level.
Asha (growth): Yes 5 mins. Run-of-show draft: 1) Host intro (2m) 2) Benchmarks + methodology (8m) 3) Demo main path (7m) 4) Fallback + routing + cost controls (6m) 5) Customer quote (3m) 6) Roadmap tie-in (5m) 7) Q&A (14m)
Kei (content): That totals 45m. Good. We should prep two Q&A starters for the host in case it's quiet.
Liam (eng): Rehearsal windows: Tue 10am PT or Thu 4pm PT. Which works?
Marta (product): Tue 10am works for me.
Ravi (sales): Tue good.
Asha (growth): Lock Tue 10 then. EventBot: scheduling stanza posted.
EventBot: Rehearsal scheduled: Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to participants.
Kei (content): Action items: I’ll finish abstracts + landing copy by tomorrow noon, plus two CTAs for A/B (Register vs. Watch demo live).
Liam (eng): I’ll produce a 2-min recorded fallback clip as a hot backup if live demo fails. Also will add per-demo ratelimit: 3rps and demo-token cap: 200.
Asha (growth): Who can create the landing page and set up the A/B?
Kei (content): I can create draft landing page. Marketing ops to implement A/B via query param.
Ravi (sales): For lead handoff, please include 'company_size' and 'use_case' fields so AE can prioritize.
Liam (eng): Will include use_case dropdown on the form.
Marta (product): One more: slide deck deadline Fri EOD. Speakers upload to the shared drive.
Asha (growth): Noted. Last ask: add a short privacy line for recordings and a checkbox for contact consent.
Kei (content): Will add both to the form and landing copy.
Asha (growth): Great. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after Keis' drafts land.
